questions.prompt: Which best describes the relationship between AI, machine learning, and generative AI?
options: They're interchangeable terms for the same thing
AI is the broad field; machine learning is one approach within it; generative AI is a subset of ML focused on creating new content
Generative AI is the broad field that contains AI and machine learning
Machine learning is a marketing term with no technical meaning

questions.prompt: What is a "hallucination" in the context of an LLM?
options: A deliberate creative-writing feature you can turn on
When the model refuses to answer a question
When the model confidently generates false or fabricated information
A type of image the model can generate

questions.prompt: What does RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) primarily add to an LLM's capability?
options: The ability to retrieve and ground responses in external/current data rather than only its training data
The ability to generate images instead of text
Faster response times with no other change
The ability to fine-tune itself automatically
A small model trained for one narrow task only
A large, broadly-trained model (like GPT or Claude) that can be adapted to many downstream tasks
The first AI model ever built
A model that only runs on-premise, never in the cloud

questions.prompt: Which of these is a core responsible-AI concern covered in Google AI Essentials Module 2?
options: Making sure the AI's interface uses a pleasing color scheme
Bias, privacy, transparency, and human oversight in AI systems
Reducing the model's file size for storage
Maximizing token throughput per second

questions.prompt: According to Google AI Essentials Module 3, what most improves the usefulness of an AI's output?
options: Always using the shortest possible prompt
Giving clear context, being specific about the desired output, and iterating on the prompt
Only ever asking yes/no questions
Avoiding follow-up questions entirely

questions.prompt: Per DeepLearning.AI's "AI For Everyone" transformation playbook, which is a recommended early step for an organization adopting AI?
options: Buy the most expensive AI vendor contract available immediately
Skip pilot projects and roll out company-wide on day one
Identify concrete use cases, run a pilot, and build internal AI literacy before scaling
Only work with data scientists — no other departments need involvement

questions.prompt: In plain terms, an "AI agent" is best described as:
options: A person who sells AI software
A system that can take a goal, make decisions, and take multi-step actions (often using tools) to accomplish it
A synonym for a chatbot with no other distinguishing features
A physical robot only
